# Getting help with OpenDash

1. **Read the docs.** The [install guide](../docs/INSTALL.md),
   [using OpenDash](../docs/USAGE.md), [connections](../docs/CONNECTIONS.md)
   and the [FAQ](../docs/FAQ.md) answer most questions.
2. **Check the app.** Connections shows what is connected and why something is
   greyed out. Settings > Server > *Open log* shows why the server stopped.
3. **Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/mahdi1190/opendash/discussions/categories/q-a).**
   Say which version, operating system and Node version you use.
4. **Found a bug?** Open an issue with the bug report form.
5. **Security problem?** Report it privately, as described in
   [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Whatever you post is public: leave out names, email addresses, task text,
money, file paths and tokens, and use demo data in screenshots.

OpenDash is maintained by volunteers in their spare time, so answers can take
a few days.
